name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::at
intro: Returns a const reference to the character at specified location pos. Bounds checking is performed, exception of type std::out_of_range will be thrown on invalid access.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the character to return

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Const reference to the requested character.

examples.output:
0: a
1: b
2: c
3: d
4: e
5: f
6: Whooops. Index is out of range.
basic_string_view::at: __pos (which is 6) >= this->size() (which is 6)

summary: Returns a const reference to the character at specified location pos. Bounds checking is performed, exception of type std::out_of_range will be thrown on invalid access.
